maddeler.e:
نتسامر (form VI)
# نَتَسَامَرُ (natasāmaru) /na.ta.saː.ma.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَسَامَرَ (tasāmara)
# نَتَسَامَرَ (natasāmara) /na.ta.saː.ma.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَسَامَرَ (tasāmara)
# نَتَسَامَرْ (natasāmar) /na.ta.saː.mar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَسَامَرَ (tasāmara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
